audit_member_text: [L44,L53-L68,L88-L115,L117-L121] (LOW/error-propagation) All MPE status returns are ignored, so event-ID allocation or log-writing failures can remain invisible while the example reports successful numerical output.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: Event-ID, description, event-logging and clock-sync return values are discarded, and the explicit MPE_Finish_log return is also ignored when NO_MPI_LOGGING is defined. That preprocessor condition only selects explicit initialization/finalization; it does not guard the other unchecked calls or prevent numerical output followed by return(0) at L124-L131 after a returned logging error.

adversarial.rationale: NO_MPI_LOGGING guards only explicit initialization/finalization; event-ID acquisition and event logging remain unconditional and their statuses remain unchecked. The bundled mpe_log.h declares integer status returns and file/memory failure codes, while the example prints its numerical result and returns zero without consulting any of them.
